fonts.display: 'Helvetica Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Helvetica Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, all structural borders, logo wordmark, button outlines — the load-bearing color of the entire system

palette.name: Gallery White
palette.role: Card surfaces, product photography backgrounds, badge fills, hero overlay text color

palette.name: Concrete Canvas
palette.role: Dominant page background — the warm-tinted gray that sets the gallery-like stage for every section

palette.name: Ash Border
palette.role: Card borders, badge outlines, subtle dividers — secondary structure below the black hairline

palette.name: Steel Mute
palette.role: Secondary text, muted button borders, caption-level borders where black feels too heavy

palette.name: Pewter Caption
palette.role: Badge and tag text — the only readable gray for small uppercase labels

palette.name: Terracotta Alert
palette.role: Input validation error borders, error state signals — the single chromatic UI color, echoing the product terracotta
